from.name: IPv4 TTL expiry plus ICMP Time Exceeded behavior

property: The diagnostic deliberately varies IP TTL so successive forwarding hops expire probes and return ICMP Time Exceeded responses, turning ordinary forwarding/error behavior into a path-discovery tool.

sources.supports: increasing-TTL probe tool and gateway/RTT reporting

negative_claims: traceroute is not an IP or ICMP protocol revision.
traceroute output is not guaranteed to be a literal complete physical topology map.
open_questions: Recover original source tarball, mailing-list archive and early kernel TTL patch.
